Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clientauth

Class ClientAuthConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.clientauth.ClientAuthConfiguration
@Configuration(value="clientAuthWebConfiguration", proxyBeanMethods=false) @EnableConfigurationProperties({MtlsProperties.class,ClientAssertionProperties.class,X509Properties.class}) public class ClientAuthConfiguration extends Object
Wires the client authentication methods private_key_jwt (with replay protection) and mutual TLS into the protocol chain. Nothing outside this feature is edited: the chain applies every ProtocolChainCustomizer bean, in order.
